cards.ex: Starting a tech company with no money is just a pipe dream.
cards.exUz: Puli yo'q texnologiya kompaniyasini boshlash shunchaki amalga oshmas orzu.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatga yaqin bo'lmagan, erishib bo'lmaydigan orzu yoki maqsad.

cards.ex: I can lose myself in a good book for hours.
cards.exUz: Men yaxshi kitobga soatlab berilib ketishim mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir butunlay sho'ng'ib ketmoq, diqqatni butunlay qaratmoq.

cards.ex: Her designs are often based on flights of fancy.
cards.exUz: Uning dizaynlari ko'pincha xayol parvozi asosida yaratiladi.
cards.uzDef: Realistik bo'lmagan, g'ayrioddiy va ijodiy xayollar.

cards.ex: Just imagine the possibilities if we invest in this project!
cards.exUz: Agar biz ushbu loyihaga sarmoya kiritsak, imkoniyatlarni tasavvur qiling!
cards.uzDef: Nimadir bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan barcha yaxshi narsalarni o'ylang.

cards.ex: "You think I'll let you borrow my car?" "In your dreams!"
cards.exUz: "Siz mening mashinamni ijaraga berishimni o'ylaysizmi?" "Xayolingizda!"
cards.uzDef: Bu hech qachon bo'lmaydi degan ma'noda ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: Let's brainstorm some ideas for the new marketing campaign.
cards.exUz: Keling, yangi marketing kampaniyasi uchun bir nechta g'oyalar bilan hujum qilaylik.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilish uchun ko'p g'oyalarni tezda o'ylab topish.

cards.ex: She often daydreams about traveling the world.
cards.exUz: U ko'pincha dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilishni xayol qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Fokusni yo'qotib, qiziqarli narsalar haqida o'ylash.

cards.ex: The monster under the bed was just a figment of his imagination.
cards.exUz: Krovat ostidagi maxluq faqat uning xayol mahsuli edi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat xayolda mavjud bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: You have to dare to dream if you want to achieve great things.
cards.exUz: Agar buyuk ishlarga erishmoqchi bo'lsangiz, orzu qilishga jur'at etishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Katta va qiyin maqsadlar qo'ymoq.

cards.ex: I got a bit carried away and bought too many souvenirs.
cards.exUz: Men biroz haddan oshib ketdim va juda ko'p sovg'alar sotib oldim.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni nazorat qila olmaslik, his-tuyg'ularga berilib ketish.

cards.ex: In this project, let your imagination run wild and create something unique.
cards.exUz: Ushbu loyihada xayolingizni erkin qo'ying va noyob narsa yarating.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday cheklovlarsiz o'ylash va tasavvur qilish.

cards.ex: The food at that restaurant was out of this world!
cards.exUz: Ushbu restorandagi ovqat olamshumul edi!
cards.uzDef: Juda yaxshi, ajoyib; odatiy holatdan tashqari.

cards.ex: Thinking they'll suddenly change their mind is just wishful thinking.
cards.exUz: Ularning birdaniga fikrini o'zgartirishini o'ylash shunchaki umidvor fikrlash.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir bo'lishini xohlaganingiz uchun shunday bo'lishiga ishonish.

cards.ex: Children often create make-believe worlds when they play.
cards.exUz: Bolalar o'ynaganda ko'pincha soxta dunyolar yaratadilar.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqiy bo'lmagan, tasavvur qilingan dunyo.

cards.ex: She dreamed up a brilliant plan to save the company.
cards.exUz: U kompaniyani saqlab qolish uchun ajoyib reja o'ylab topdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi, g'ayrioddiy g'oya yoki rejani tasavvur qilish.

cards.ex: He spends all his time building castles in the air instead of working.
cards.exUz: U ishlash o'rniga butun vaqtini osmondagi qal'alarni qurishga sarflaydi.
cards.uzDef: Asoslanmagan, amalga oshirib bo'lmaydigan orzular haqida o'ylash.

cards.ex: She had a creative spark that inspired everyone around her.
cards.exUz: Uning ijodiy uchquni bor edi, u atrofidagi hamma odamlarni ilhomlantirdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va ijodiy g'oyalarni yaratish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: Their promises of quick riches are just pie in the sky.
cards.exUz: Ularning tez boyib ketish haqidagi va'dalari shunchaki osmondagi pirog.
cards.uzDef: Amalga oshishi ehtimoli kam bo'lgan g'oya yoki va'da.

cards.ex: To solve this problem, we need to think outside the box.
cards.exUz: Ushbu muammoni hal qilish uchun biz qolipdan tashqari o'ylashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Odatdagidan farqli va yangi fikrlash.

cards.ex: His explanation for being late was a bit far-fetched.
cards.exUz: Uning kechikishiga sabab bo'lgan izohi biroz quruq xayol edi.
cards.uzDef: Ishonish qiyin bo'lgan g'oya; g'alati fikr.

cards.ex: She was so lost in thought that she didn't hear me come in.
cards.exUz: U shunchalik fikrga botgan ediki, meni kirganimni sezmadi.
cards.uzDef: Chuqur o'y-hayollarga berilgan holat.

cards.ex: He has a vivid imagination and loves to tell stories.
cards.exUz: U yorqin tasavvurga ega va hikoyalar aytishni yaxshi ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli va aniq tasavvurga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: Travel can fuel your imagination and inspire new ideas.
cards.exUz: Sayohat sizning xayolingizni oziqlantirishi va yangi g'oyalarni ilhomlantirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Tasavvur qilish va ijod qilishga yordam beradigan narsalar.

cards.ex: He lives in a dream world and doesn't face reality.
cards.exUz: U xayoliy olamda yashaydi va haqiqatga duch kelmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatdan uzoqlashgan, fantaziyalar bilan to'ldirilgan dunyoda.

cards.ex: The success of the project was beyond my wildest dreams.
cards.exUz: Loyiha muvaffaqiyati mening eng yovvoyi orzuyimdan ham o'tib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Eng yaxshi tasavvurdan ham a'lo darajada.

cards.ex: He seems to create money out of thin air.
cards.exUz: U hech narsadan pul yaratadiganga o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday asos yoki oldindan tayyorgarliksiz paydo bo'lish.

cards.ex: She's a daydream believer, always hoping for the best.
cards.exUz: U xayolparast, doimo eng yaxshisiga umid qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Hayolga beriladigan, orzularga ishonadigan odam.

cards.ex: My advice is to follow your dreams, no matter what others say.
cards.exUz: Mening maslahatim, boshqalar nima desa ham, orzularingizga ergashing.
cards.uzDef: Xohlagan narsangizga erishish uchun harakat qiling.

cards.ex: The artist's work requires a leap of imagination.
cards.exUz: Rassomning ishi tasavvur sakrashini talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va ijodiy narsani yaratish uchun katta tasavvurga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The beautiful music cast a spell over the audience.
cards.exUz: Chiroyli musiqa tomoshabinlarni afsun qildi.
cards.uzDef: Sehrlamoq, qandaydir jozibali ta'sir ko'rsatmoq.
